The keyboard of #1 reads the end of this line but not its start, and its Taipei twin ETen (倚天) the other way round. Compare the two keyboard pictures on the site.
x03 comes four times in a row, and it reads on both keyboards. The one handover falls inside that run, not at its edge.
Each keyboard keeps two of the four x03. On ETen they make a word meaning 'often'; on Dàqiān, one meaning 'lazily'.
